Container.Name: Dell-iDRAC-Fan-Controller
Container.Overview: Controls Dell PowerEdge fan speeds via iDRAC IPMI with stepped or interpolated fan curves.
Container.Description: Controls Dell PowerEdge fan speeds via iDRAC IPMI. Supports standard, stepped, and interpolated fan curve modes.

Config.Name: iDRAC Host
Config.Description: IP address of your iDRAC, or 'local' if running on the server itself

Config.Name: Check Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How often to read temps and adjust fan speed

Config.Name: Baseline Fan Speed %
Config.Description: Minimum fan speed % used in all modes

Config.Name: CPU Temperature Threshold (Dell hand-back)
Config.Description: Degrees C above which Dell takes back fan control

Config.Name: [Stepped] Mid Temp °C
Config.Description: Temp to switch to mid fan speed (stepped mode only)

Config.Name: [Stepped] Mid Fan Speed %
Config.Description: Fan speed % at mid stage (stepped mode only)

Config.Name: [Stepped] High Temp °C
Config.Description: Temp to switch to high fan speed (stepped mode only)

Config.Name: [Stepped] High Fan Speed %
Config.Description: Fan speed % at high stage (stepped mode only)

Config.Name: [Interpolate] Ramp Start Temp °C
Config.Description: Temp where fan ramping begins (interpolate mode only)

Config.Name: [Interpolate] Ramp End Temp °C
Config.Description: Temp at max fan speed (interpolate mode only)

Config.Name: [Interpolate] Max Fan Speed %
Config.Description: Max fan speed % at ramp end (interpolate mode only)

Config.Name: Disable PCIe Cooling Response
Config.Description: Gen 13 and older only - set false for Gen 14+ (R740xd etc)

Config.Name: Keep PCIe Cooling State On Exit
